description: Manifest routes that mount only when their deployment gate is configured. Consulted ONLY by the reverse completeness check (every manifest route is mounted). The forward security check -- every mounted route must carry a policy -- is never relaxed.

routes.reason: Pending verified Google signup metadata mounts with the OAuth graph. The handler requires an expiring browser capability cookie.
Google workspace creation mounts with the OAuth graph and requires the expiring capability plus CSRF proof.

MountOAuthRoutes: 'A nil OAuth graph is the supported password-only deployment mode.' OAuth needs provider-issued credentials, so a public compose file cannot supply them; requiring these routes makes password-only unbootable.
Callback half of the pair above; the two mount together or not at all.

Issuance and ingestion share one switch by design, so a deployment can never collect fetches for decoys it is not sending. An empty secret means this deployment has not opted into embedding decoys in customer mail.
Inbox Reality additionally requires object storage, a deliverability URL, a bearer token and signing secrets; enabling it without them is refused at startup.
Second half of the Inbox Reality internal callback pair.
Campaign polls require a dedicated token secret and an absolute HTTPS base URL, validated at startup.
Public poll preview. The GET/POST split IS the prefetch mitigation, so both mount together.
Public poll record; same gate as its GET preview.

directSendingProvisionRouteEnabled: in production the direct provisioning endpoint mounts only when POSTWAVE_ALLOW_DIRECT_PROVISION is true (an operator escape hatch the launch checklist requires unset), so a production deployment without it must still boot; outside production it always mounts.
